archive.censor.body: The board objects to a skull being thrown about and suggests a ball. The studio replied the same day: "He enjoys it."
archive.censor.title: Letter from the censor
archive.clipping.body: FIRE AT CARTOON STUDIO. On the night before its premiere, a projector fire destroyed the only print of a new short. Staff say it was "cut to pieces before it burned".
archive.clipping.title: Newspaper clipping
archive.cuesheet.body: Reel One: graveyard waltz. Reel Three: something in a minor key, with a pumpkin in it. Reel Eight: whatever the organist can manage while the building is on fire.
archive.cuesheet.title: Music cue sheet
archive.deleted.body: The clock strikes thirteen and every clock in town stops to listen. Cut for time. The clock did not agree.
archive.deleted.title: Deleted scene: the thirteenth hour
archive.diary.body: Drew four hundred frames of Morty spinning today. My hand is a claw. Tomorrow, the pumpkin.
archive.diary.title: An animator's diary
archive.ledger.body: Inkers, $14 a week. Painters, $16. Mortimer Bones: "paid in bones", written in the margin in someone else's hand.
archive.ledger.title: Payroll ledger
archive.letter.body: If anybody finds the pieces, I'd like my hat back first, then the rest, then maybe a sandwich. — M.B.
archive.letter.how: Get four of Morty's pieces back
archive.letter.title: A letter in Morty's handwriting
archive.memo.body: To all animators: the skull short, working title Mortimer Bones in Skull Toss, is to be finished by Halloween. Eight reels. No overtime. — H.K., production
archive.memo.title: Studio memo
archive.modelsheet.body: Round cranium, big sockets, four teeth up and three down. He must squash and stretch like a rubber ball. Never draw his jaw off the hinge unless he's talking.
archive.modelsheet.title: Model sheet: Mortimer Bones
archive.projnote.body: It wasn't me. The film was cutting itself. I heard it laughing. — found in the booth, pinned to an empty reel can
archive.projnote.title: The projectionist's note
archive.restoration.body: All eight reels recovered and spliced. Condition: haunted, but complete. The skull appears to wink at the end of Reel Eight. We have checked. He does.
archive.restoration.title: Restoration report
archive.storyboard.body: Panel 12: the crow lands on the ring and puffs up. Panel 13: Morty goes straight through the crow. Make it look like it hurt the crow more.
archive.storyboard.title: Storyboard notes: the Crow King
board.rival: Next up: {name} at {score}. Beat it to pass them.
board.top: You're at the top. Everyone's chasing you now.

coach.bat: Wait for the bat to pass
coach.bone: Watch the shadows: a bone is falling
coach.clank: Close. Aim for the middle of the ring

codex.boss.batbaron: A bat with a title he bought from a vampire. He dives at anything that glints.
codex.boss.clockking: Wound up in 1933 and never wound down. He keeps Morty's pocket watch to tell the time the wrong way.
codex.boss.count: He dines at dusk, sleeps till noon, and borrowed Morty's bow tie for a funeral in 1933.
codex.boss.crow: King of the cemetery's crows. He took the ring for a crown and won't give it back without a fight.
codex.boss.cuckoo: It has been striking thirteen since 1933, and it's sure it's the only clock that's right.
codex.boss.gator: He ferried souls across the bayou until the chapel flooded. Now he ferries grudges.
codex.boss.jester: The midway's jack-in-the-box. Nobody wound him up; he wound himself.
codex.boss.madame: She runs the bayou's mud baths with a strict no-refunds policy. Morty's spats have been soaking for ninety years.
codex.boss.marrowroot: The oldest tree in the orchard grew right round Morty's cane, and it means to keep it.
codex.boss.owl: Built from the bones the orchard drops. He only ever says two things, and both of them are "hoo".
codex.boss.projectionist: He ran the projector the night the reel was cut. He says it wasn't him. It was him.
codex.boss.pumpkin: King of the patch, and very, very ripe. He spits his seeds at anything that moves.
codex.boss.reaper: He cut the cartoon into pieces and scattered them, and he kept the last one: Morty's shadow.
codex.boss.ringmaster: He rigged every game on the midway, then rigged the midway. Morty's whistle keeps his act in tune.
codex.boss.scarecrow: Stuffed in 1911 and in a mood ever since. The crows ignore him, so he takes it out on Morty.
codex.boss.undertaker: He buried Morty's top hat with a note: "Too dapper for the dead." He digs graves for fun at weekends.
codex.hazard.balloons.body: Carnival balloons drift across the lane. Hit one and it costs a skull.
codex.hazard.balloons.name: Balloons
codex.hazard.bats.body: They cross the lane in the Crooked Crypts. One screech, then they come.
codex.hazard.bats.name: Bats
codex.hazard.bonefall.body: The orchard drops its harvest whenever it likes. Watch the shadows.
codex.hazard.bonefall.name: Falling bones
codex.hazard.fog.body: It rolls over the bayou and hides the ring. The ring is still there.
codex.hazard.fog.name: Fog
codex.hazard.jumpcut.body: In the Final Reel the film skips, and the ring skips with it. The flicker comes first.
codex.hazard.jumpcut.name: Jump cuts
codex.hazard.pendulum.body: The belfry's pendulum sweeps the lane. Count the ticks and throw between swings.
codex.hazard.pendulum.name: The pendulum
codex.hazard.wind.body: It gusts through the pumpkin patch and bends every throw. The sign under the score says which way.
codex.hazard.wind.name: Wind
codex.how.piece: Beat the end boss holding it
codex.map.1: Where the reel was buried. The gravedigger is still digging, and nobody has asked him what for.
codex.map.2: The crypts lean on each other like mourners at a wake. Mind the bats.
codex.map.3: The pumpkins grin back, the scarecrow has opinions, and the wind has more.
codex.map.4: The trees grow bones instead of apples, and harvest season is loud.
codex.map.5: The chapel bell still rings under the water on Sundays. The fog comes and goes as it likes.
codex.map.6: The midway that never closed. Every game is rigged and every prize is haunted.
codex.map.7: It has been thirteen o'clock since 1933. The pendulum doesn't care whose head is in the way.
codex.map.8: The picture palace where the last print is kept. The film jumps, and so does everything else.
codex.power.blast: A stick of cartoon dynamite labelled BONK. Stand well back.
codex.power.cursed: A purple hex from the Count's cellar. Everything's faster and worth three times as much.
codex.power.deadeye: One of the projectionist's lenses, still sharp. The middle of the ring gets twice as wide.
codex.power.ghost: Morty goes see-through for a while, and rims, seeds and bats pass right through him.
codex.power.magnet: A horseshoe that only attracts bones. Every make pays extra.
codex.power.rush: A skull that's late for something. It flies fast and gets there early.
codex.power.second: A spare life from the prop department. Your next miss doesn't count.
codex.target.bell.body: A small bell that has been waiting to ring since 1933.
codex.target.bell.name: Belfry bell
codex.target.bonefruit.name: Bone-fruit
codex.target.brazier.body: A crypt's fire basket. Knock it and it roars.
codex.target.brazier.name: Brazier
codex.target.duck.body: A tin duck from the shooting gallery. Everyone's aiming at it.
codex.target.duck.name: Gallery duck
codex.target.filmcan.body: A can from the lost reel. Hit it and a piece of the picture rattles inside.
codex.target.filmcan.name: Film can
codex.target.frog.body: It sits on a lily pad and objects loudly.
codex.target.frog.name: Bayou frog
codex.target.jack.body: A pumpkin with a grin. It splats.
codex.target.jack.name: Jack-o'-lantern
codex.target.wisp.body: A lantern light that floats behind the ring in the cemetery.
codex.target.wisp.name: Will-o'-the-wisp

cont.short: Not enough bones for this one.
cont.sr: Out of skulls. Continue for {n} bones? {secs} seconds.
director.from: From the desk of H.K., head of production
director.twist.bonanza.line: "Twice the props behind that ring. Knock them down."
director.twist.bonanza.name: Bonus Bonanza
director.twist.cursed.line: "The whole reel's hexed. Three times the score, and hurry up."
director.twist.cursed.name: The Cursed Reel
director.twist.fog.line: "We're shooting at night. Fog's on the house."
director.twist.fog.name: Night Shoot
director.twist.rush.line: "Speed it up thirty per cent. We're over budget."
director.twist.rush.name: Rush Hour
director.twist.shrink.line: "Every time you get it through, make it smaller. Audiences love that."
director.twist.shrink.name: The Shrinking Ring
director.twist.wind.line: "Give me weather! Twice the wind, on whatever set we're on."
director.twist.wind.name: Double Wind
fragment.bowtie.line: The Count wore it to every funeral. Nobody asked.
fragment.bowtie.name: Bow Tie
fragment.cane.line: Grafted onto a branch. It had started to bud.
fragment.cane.name: Cane
fragment.gloves.line: Four fingers each, as the studio's style sheet required.
fragment.gloves.name: White Gloves
fragment.shadow.line: The last piece. Without it, nothing else could stand up.
fragment.shadow.name: Shadow
fragment.spats.line: Soaked through, but they still tap.
fragment.spats.name: Spats
fragment.tophat.line: He buried it with a note: 'Too dapper for the dead.'
fragment.tophat.name: Top Hat
fragment.watch.line: Still set to the minute the reel was cut.
fragment.watch.name: Pocket Watch
fragment.whistle.line: Morty's voice, kept in a tin whistle for the midway.
fragment.whistle.name: Whistle

morty.bonk.04: I'm seeing stars. That's new, for a skull.
morty.bonk.06: That thing owes me an apology.
morty.boss.batbaron.01: A bat with a title? Now I've heard everything.
morty.boss.batbaron.02: Keep your fangs to yourself, Baron!
morty.boss.clockking.01: He stole my watch. The nerve!
morty.boss.count.01: Count Crookula? More like Count Crook!
morty.boss.count.02: He wore my bow tie to a funeral!
morty.boss.cuckoo.01: Cuckoo! Cuckoo! Oh, I get it.
morty.boss.cuckoo.02: This bird's got a screw loose. Several.
morty.boss.gator.02: He's all teeth and no manners.
morty.boss.jester.01: Pop goes the weasel. Pop goes ME.
morty.boss.jester.02: Wind him up and watch him go. Ugh.
morty.boss.madame.01: Madame Muck! She's got my spats!
morty.boss.marrowroot.01: A tree made of bones? That's my whole family!
morty.boss.owl.02: A bone owl. Is that a cousin of mine?
morty.boss.projectionist.01: Hey, that's the guy who cut me up!
morty.boss.reaper.01: This guy cut the reel. All of it.
morty.boss.reaper.02: Last piece, last fight. No pressure.
morty.boss.ringmaster.01: Step right up and give me my whistle!
morty.boss.ringmaster.02: The whole midway's rigged. Even him.
morty.boss.scarecrow.01: He's got opinions and hay for brains.
morty.boss.undertaker.01: Oh, it's HIM. He buried my hat.
morty.bossdown.06: Ha! Didn't even need my whole body.
morty.continue.04: Don't leave me in the pouch!
morty.cursed.03: I can hear violins. Spooky ones.
morty.cursed.04: Somebody lift this hex, I'm itchy!
morty.end.01: Roll the credits! I'm all here!
morty.end.02: Top hat, tails, the works. Morty Bones is BACK.
morty.fragment.bowtie.01: The bow tie! Now I'm presentable.
morty.fragment.gloves.01: Four fingers each, just how I like 'em.
morty.fragment.shadow.01: My shadow! I was starting to feel see-through.
morty.fragment.tophat.01: My hat! I feel taller already.
morty.grab.01: Hey! What do you think you're doing?!
morty.grab.06: I just got my jaw back on!
morty.grab.09: My agent will hear about this!
morty.grab.11: Aim for the hoop, not the tree!
morty.grab.12: I'm too old for this. I'm like 300.
morty.grab.14: At least buy me dinner first!
morty.grab.23: Do you even have a licence for this?
morty.grab.24: Tell my bones I love them.
morty.grab.26: Do you know who I am?! I'm Morty Bones!
morty.grab.28: Call me Morty. Everybody does, right before they throw me.
morty.hot.05: Get the newsreel boys in here!
morty.hot.06: We're a double act now, kid!
morty.idle.02: Take your time. I've got eternity.
morty.idle.06: I could do this in my sleep. Wait, am I asleep?
morty.last.02: No pressure, pal. None at all.
morty.last.03: This is fine. This is FINE.
morty.last.04: Whatever happens, I forgive you. Probably.
morty.last.05: My whole life is flashing before my sockets!
morty.map.1.01: Home sweet home. Mind the gravedigger.
morty.map.2.01: The Crypts. Don't touch the silver.
morty.map.3.01: Pumpkins everywhere. Smells like a trap.
morty.map.4.01: Bones growing on trees? Now I've seen everything.
morty.map.5.01: The Bayou. I can't swim. I can't anything.
morty.map.6.01: The carnival! Every game's rigged. Including this one.
morty.map.7.01: Thirteen o'clock. Never a good sign.
morty.map.8.01: The Final Reel. Break a leg. Not mine.
morty.meta.03: Don't mind the scratches. It's vintage.
morty.meta.05: I've been stuck in this reel since 1933.
morty.meta.06: Who keeps drawing these rings, anyway?
morty.missing.05: I've seen better throws from a scarecrow.
morty.nearmiss.01: So close I could taste it!
morty.perfect.08: I'd tip my hat if I had one.
morty.power.cursed.01: Uh oh. That's the bad kind of purple.
morty.power.second.01: A safety net. Finally, some respect.
morty.resume.01: Where'd you go? I was mid-sentence!
morty.sig.01: Did you get that on film?!
morty.sig.04: They'll be talking about that in 1934!
morty.sig.06: I meant to do that. YOU meant to do that.

secret.caught.body: A tap on the animator's hand while it was in the picture.
secret.caught.hint: Someone reaches into the picture now and then. Catch them.
secret.caught.name: Caught in the Act
secret.knock.body: Morty, poked thirteen times on the title screen. He's ticklish.
secret.knock.hint: Who's there? Poke him and find out.
secret.knock.name: Knock Knock
secret.moon.body: Three throws in a row sailed clean over the ring. Morty has been to the moon, and he says it's overrated.
secret.moon.hint: Aim higher. Much higher. Three times.
secret.moon.name: Moonshot
secret.name.body: A headstone with Morty's own name on it. He'd like a word.
secret.name.hint: Whose name goes on the stone?
secret.name.name: Name Dropping
secret.projector.body: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A, typed on the title screen. The Two-Strip Color reel comes out of the vault.
secret.projector.hint: An old projector had a code. It went up and down a lot.
secret.projector.name: The Old Projector's Code
secret.showstopper.hint: Stop the show during a curtain call.
secret.showstopper.name: Showstopper
secret.thirteen.body: Thirteen makes in a row in the Clockwork Belfry, where it's always thirteen o'clock.
secret.thirteen.hint: The belfry strikes a certain number.
secret.thirteen.name: The Thirteenth Hour
secret.upside.body: Five throws pulled up instead of down in a single run. The skull does not go that way.
secret.upside.hint: Try it the other way. Keep trying.
secret.upside.name: Wrong Way Round
secret.winks.body: The title screen left alone for a whole minute, until Morty dozed off on the logo.
secret.winks.hint: Leave him be for a while.
secret.winks.name: Forty Winks
